title: Which Rider Premium Charges are Counted When Arrears are Settled
content:
The standing of one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders settles which of the rider premium charges on its premium account are counted toward the money the member is asked for.

## The rule

1. Where the rider stands suspended for unpaid premium, every rider premium charge posted to the rider premium account is counted, however long ago it was posted.
2. Where the rider stands in its waiting period, only the rider premium charges posted from the day benefits became payable are counted.
3. Otherwise, only the rider premium charges posted within the days of grace the rider held allows are counted.

## The span in the third case

The days of grace the rider held allows are reckoned into whole months at thirty days to the month, any part month being dropped, and the span runs back over that many whole calendar months from the handling date; a charge posted in an earlier calendar month falls outside it.

| Rider | Days of grace allowed | Whole months the span runs back over |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 60 | 2 |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 60 | 2 |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 60 | 2 |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 60 | 2 |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 90 | 3 |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 90 | 3 |

## Points of judgement

**A suspended rider is counted without any span at all.** Every charge on the account is counted, whatever month it was posted in.

**A rider in its waiting period is counted forward from one date.** The charges posted from the day benefits became payable are counted, and those posted before that day are not.

**Any other standing is counted over the span.** The charges posted within that many whole calendar months back from the handling date are counted.

## Worked on hypothetical inputs

A rider premium account carries four charges of 28.60 USD each, posted in four successive calendar months up to and including the month of handling. The rider allows 60 days of grace, giving a span of 2 whole months.

- With the rider **suspended for unpaid premium**, all four are counted: 114.40 USD.
- With the rider **in neither of the first two standings**, the two posted within the span are counted: 57.20 USD.
- With the rider **in its waiting period**, benefits having become payable at the start of the third of those four months, the last two are counted: 57.20 USD.
